**Superseded by #8978**, opened against `main` with the rebased and validated implementation at `436688a90`. Continue review there.

- [ ] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.

## What does this PR do?

Make `cfg.data` authoritative for the GPT-family data path inside the training loop. Loaders read their type, workers, sharding, pinning and persistence from `cfg.data.dataloader`. Batch construction, SFT loss reporting and distillation read the dataset's computed flags; training, evaluation, packed forward metadata and telemetry read the dataset's sample length.

`--no-pin-memory` and `--no-persistent-workers` expose the existing config fields. Defaults preserve current CLI behavior. The container adds the corresponding data/model validation checks for Python and YAML configurations, without mutating model settings or removing legacy CLI validation.

Part of #3554; follows the merged data-section PR #8341.

## Compatibility and remaining scope

- Keep sample length, model position capacity and packing budget distinct. Loader-only sections retain the legacy sequence-length fallback; containers without a model section retain model-argument fallbacks.
- Keep SFT's default collate separate from varlen's identity collate, and preserve the current batch/distillation `cu_seqlens` formula.
- Preserve public signatures and serialization shape. No Megatron Core production change.
- Estimator/JIT internals await #8234's explicit-input APIs. Phase-transition scheduling, SFT loss-log mode, decoder/encoder lengths and distillation blend/cache identity remain with their current owners.
- Provider registry, loader-module extraction, `drop_last` behavior and Bridge convergence remain separate work.

## Sync and integration

Rebased onto `main` at `21334a44e` on November 4, 2026, and pushed to [the implementation branch](https://github.com/asolergi-nv/Megatron-LM/tree/datasetconfig/pr2-loop) at `436688a90`. GitHub currently still reports the previous head for this closed PR; [review the pushed diff here](https://github.com/asolergi-nv/Megatron-LM/compare/21334a44ede0b8497d1770d0b80bc115e777bd00...436688a90eac46fbb0ad467cd1e31c2697f92e2e). Preserves upstream's transformer-config cache, packing datasets on every pipeline stage, and removal of GRPO calculator reinitialization. Updated iterator/cache test fixtures and migrated the newly added GPT forward-step `tokens_per_sample` reader, with stale/missing-args regression cases.

Current rehearsals: #8234 (`91f130213`) conflicts in 13 files; #8401 (`7da1a935b`) conflicts in `test_get_batch.py`. #8234 now constructs missing model sections and consolidates layout/serialization APIs. Whichever lands second must preserve the data checks, configured-CP/GTP arithmetic, sample-length consumers and tokenizer binding, then test the combined tree. No dependency changes are included here.

## Validation

- Two local A6000 GPUs, `mlm-workstation:26.09-py3`: 1928 passed / 311 skipped / 33 failed per rank; matching main selection 1889 / 311 / 33. All 33 failure IDs match exactly across both ranks and both trees. Failures concern GPU count/backend support, unavailable RL dependencies and kernel-cache permissions; the broad suite is not fully green.
- Recipe corpus: 298 cases, 272 equal validated namespaces, 26 matched failures, zero mismatches. 205/209 training containers validate and finalize; four need the initialized runtime microbatch calculator. Positive and negative packing-validation controls pass.
- Four two-GPU comparisons against current main match all nine compared training metrics over iterations 1–20: SFT, varlen, PP=2 with capacity 64/sample length 32, and TP=2 with inter-document masking. All eight training runs exited successfully. This establishes equality of logged metrics, not a bitwise tensor comparison.
- Pinned Black/isort/Pylint/Ruff and copyright checks pass. Optional mypy was unavailable.
- Fresh CI, eight-GPU/FIM-asset coverage and a current Bridge B1 rerun remain outstanding. Previous October evidence is not claimed as a new run.

## Replacement PR

GitHub closed this PR after #8341 merged and its base `pull-request/8341` was deleted. Reopening and retargeting were rejected while the base was missing, and restoring the base was blocked by repository restrictions. Replacement #8978 carries the updated implementation and validation evidence; this PR remains closed for historical review context.

+"""The seams between the run config and the legacy arguments inside the training loop.
+
+The helpers are pure functions of the container and the argument namespace, called at the
+application boundary with ``get_run_config()`` and ``get_args()``; the config classes read no
+global.
+
+``data_sequence_length``: the sample length the loop runs at. ``cfg.data.dataset.sequence_length``
+when the section has a dataset; ``args.seq_length``, read only in that case, for the entry points
+whose datasets come from their own callbacks (their remaining ``args`` dependency until their
+dataset configs exist). The namespace is not touched when the section has a dataset, so a stale or
+missing ``args.seq_length`` cannot leak into a GPT run.
+
+``model_topology`` and ``model_layout``: the model-parallel values the data path reads. From
+``cfg.model.transformer`` when the container has a model section; from the namespace for a
+container built without ``model_cfg`` (``pretrain_hybrid_flex.py`` today). That fallback is a
+compatibility condition of the container, not of one script, and goes when every container has a
+model section.
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Optional
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class ModelTopology:
+    """The model-parallel values the loader, ``get_batch`` and ``dummy_train_step`` read."""
+
+    context_parallel_size: int
+    pipeline_model_parallel_size: int
+    dynamic_context_parallel: bool
+    sequence_packing_scheduler: Optional[str]
+    source: str
+    """``"model"`` (read from ``cfg.model.transformer``) or ``"args"`` (no model section)."""
+
+
+def _transformer(cfg: Any) -> Any:
+    return getattr(getattr(cfg, "model", None), "transformer", None)
+
+
+def model_topology(cfg: Any, args: Any) -> ModelTopology:
+    """The model-parallel values the data path reads, from the model section when there is one."""
+    transformer = _transformer(cfg)
+    if transformer is not None:
+        return ModelTopology(
+            context_parallel_size=transformer.context_parallel_size,
+            pipeline_model_parallel_size=transformer.pipeline_model_parallel_size,
+            dynamic_context_parallel=bool(transformer.dynamic_context_parallel),
+            sequence_packing_scheduler=transformer.sequence_packing_scheduler,
+            source="model",
+        )
+    return ModelTopology(
+        context_parallel_size=args.context_parallel_size,
+        pipeline_model_parallel_size=args.pipeline_model_parallel_size,
+        dynamic_context_parallel=bool(args.dynamic_context_parallel),
+        sequence_packing_scheduler=args.sequence_packing_scheduler,
+        source="args",
+    )
+
+
+def model_transformer_config(cfg: Any, args: Any) -> Any:
+    """The transformer config the batch path reads (``get_batch``): the model section's when the
+    container has one, else the one the legacy arguments describe (what ``get_batch`` built from
+    the arguments on every call before the container carried a model section)."""
+    transformer = _transformer(cfg)
+    if transformer is None:
+        from megatron.training.arguments import core_transformer_config_from_args
+
+        transformer = core_transformer_config_from_args(args)
+    return transformer
+
+
+def model_layout(cfg: Any, args: Any) -> tuple[Any, Optional[int]]:
+    """``(pipeline_model_parallel_layout, mtp_num_layers)`` for the rank predicate, from
+    ``model_transformer_config``."""
+    transformer = model_transformer_config(cfg, args)
+    return transformer.pipeline_model_parallel_layout, transformer.mtp_num_layers
+
+
+def data_sequence_length(cfg: Any, args: Any) -> int:
+    """The sample length the loop runs at: the dataset's when the section has one, else the
+    namespace's (read only then)."""
+    dataset = getattr(getattr(cfg, "data", None), "dataset", None)
+    if dataset is not None:
+        return dataset.sequence_length
+    return args.seq_length
